identityPolicy: Sorted original element IDs allocate positive numeric page-local IDs; sorted relationship IDs follow the largest element ID. Stable external identities live in taxonomy.id Shape Data, independently of numeric IDs and display names.
timestampPolicy: Historical generatedAt remains snapshotCreatedAt with SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_CREATED_AT. exportedAt is the actual export creation time, captured once with the authenticated actor and build version. Bytes are reproducible for the same graph, authority and export context; independent downloads may have different creation times.

mappings.target: typed taxonomy.* Shape Data, reusable native masters and manifest
mappings.rationale: Original embedded block, process, role, application, information and service masters use familiar editable diagram symbols. Unknown types use the generic block. Exact business semantics remain properties; no Microsoft stencil assets or invented server/database semantics are included.

mappings.target: typed taxonomy.* connector Shape Data, native connector master and manifest
mappings.rationale: Native editable 1-D arrow geometry shows source-to-target direction. BeginX/EndX depend on documented boundary connection points and matching Connect records. Static point glue follows the attached point; automatic side switching is not promised. Exact relation semantics remain properties.

mappings.source: authorized snapshot authority and human decisions
mappings.target: OPC custom properties, shape data and manifest
mappings.rationale: Only application-allowlisted values are supplied; unavailable authority and decisions are named in the loss report.

mappings.source: original requirement text, historical version author/date, export actor/time and software name/version
mappings.target: editable diagram context and mandatory Requirement pages, native document properties and manifest
mappings.rationale: Saved exports use the exact authorized historical requirement version. Working-view source is explicitly client-provided and has no frozen authority. Diagram excerpts are labeled; complete original text is paginated within the shared evidence budget without silent truncation. Missing historical author/date are not replaced by export actor/time.

mappings.source: authorized persisted project and requirement identity
mappings.target: literal native requirement hyperlink and typed properties
mappings.rationale: The application constructs the exact requirement editing route from trusted public-base configuration, never request Host/Forwarded headers. HTTP(S) links carry no credentials or access tokens, do not select workspace/branch automatically, and require normal authentication and scope authorization. Unconfigured or unsaved targets have an explicit unavailable status.
Presentation geometry may differ from SVG/PDF; semantic identities and directions do not depend on layout.

mappings.source: labels, recorded reasons and relationship identity
mappings.target: upright bounded captions, compact display keys, linked readable evidence pages and optional native detail pages
mappings.rationale: Full recorded reasons and shortened labels are visible on paginated evidence pages, linked from native shapes and connectors. Exact values remain in Shape Data. Sorted-ID presentation keys do not create semantic objects. Complete overview, impact and evidence pages take precedence over optional graphical details within separate bounded page budgets and the unchanged shared byte/shape/connector limits; capacity failure never silently removes reasons.

mappings.target: native container master, container marker and reciprocal membership relationships
mappings.rationale: Recorded container flags and parent IDs define membership; geometric overlap alone does not. Page coordinates stay flat, with container bounds around members. Containers remain excluded from the canonical semantic graph hash.

mappings.source: prompts,raw provider responses,raw unscoped source evidence,warnings
mappings.rationale: Raw model-level payloads remain outside the visual handoff profile. Original requirement text and recorded scoped relationship evidence are deliberately retained; supplied review metadata remains authoritative.

mappings.source: self-loops,coincident shape centers,unresolvable coincident boundary endpoints
mappings.rationale: The native connector profile requires distinct shape centers and boundary endpoint positions. Touching selected sides use adjacent fixed ports where possible; no partial artifact is emitted.
Editing or saving a VSDX does not write back to Taxonomy or preserve canonical operation history.
